gloss: corner sink strainer; kitchen sink corner basket

definitions.gloss: corner sink strainer, kitchen corner basket
definitions.explanation: A small triangular basket or container placed in the corner of a kitchen sink to collect food scraps and garbage while washing dishes. A standard item in Japanese kitchens.

examples.japanese: {三角|さんかく}コーナー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てて→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧。
examples.english: Throw away the garbage in the sink strainer.

examples.japanese: {三角|さんかく}コーナー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かぶせる。
examples.english: Put a net over the sink strainer.

examples.english: If you don't clean the sink strainer regularly, it can become a source of bad smells.

notes:
Named for its triangular shape, which fits into the corner of a sink. Found in most Japanese kitchens. Usually used with a disposable net (⟦{水切|みずき}り→水切り：08573_mizukiri⟧⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧) to make cleanup easier.

Recently, some households are adopting a {三角|さんかく}コーナーなし lifestyle, opting to dispose of food scraps directly into garbage bags to save sink space and reduce odor.
